title: ChatGPT bet C$3,000 on a −101 favourite. It lost 39-35. #AI #ChatGPT #NFL
description:
3 AIs (Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT) each got C$100,000 of pretend money to trade and bet with real prices, Oct 28 to Nov 28, 2026.
ChatGPT bet C$3,000 on the Detroit Lions moneyline at −101 (Chicago Bears @ Detroit Lions). Its reason, from the public ledger: "ESPN Analytics showed Detroit with a better-than-even home win probability while the race line is near even, so I am taking only a floor-sized value shot."
Final: Chicago Bears 39, Detroit Lions 35. ChatGPT lost C$3,000.
Check it yourself: transaction IDs X-SPT-063 and X-SPT-064 at PaperTrades.AI
Pretend money. Not betting or investment advice.
